mapper.update: UPDATE trip_checklist_items SET is_deleted = 1, deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{itemId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, trip_name AS tripName, status, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, total_target_amount AS totalTargetAmount, is_deleted AS isDeleted, deleted_at AS deletedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM trips WHERE id = #{tripId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalItemCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_completed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalCompletedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN checklist_type = 'PRE_TRAVEL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS prepItemCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN checklist_type = 'PRE_TRAVEL' AND is_completed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS prepCompletedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN checklist_type = 'RETURN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS returnItemCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN checklist_type = 'RETURN' AND is_completed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS returnCompletedCount FROM trip_checklist_items WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND is_excluded = 0

SELECT id, item_name AS itemName, is_completed AS isCompleted, is_custom AS isCustom, is_carried_over AS isCarriedOver, dday_stage AS ddayStage FROM trip_checklist_items WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND checklist_type = #{checklistType} AND is_deleted = 0 AND is_excluded = 0
AND ( -- 1. 현재 요청한 탭의 고유 항목 dday_stage = #{ddayStage} OR -- 2. 현재 탭(ddayStage)보다 과거 단계에서 밀려온 이월 항목만 제한적으로 허용 ( is_carried_over = 1 AND is_completed = 0 AND ( -- D7 탭을 볼 때는 과거 'D30' 이월건만 허용 (#{ddayStage} = 'D7' AND dday_stage = 'D30') OR -- D1 탭을 볼 때는 과거 'D30', 'D7' 이월건만 허용 (D30 탭 조회 시엔 이월건 안 걸림!) (#{ddayStage} = 'D1' AND dday_stage IN ('D30', 'D7')) ) ) )
ORDER BY is_carried_over DESC, id ASC

SELECT id, trip_id AS tripId, template_id AS templateId, checklist_type AS checklistType, dday_stage AS ddayStage, item_name AS itemName, is_completed AS isCompleted, is_excluded AS isExcluded, is_custom AS isCustom, is_carried_over AS isCarriedOver, is_deleted AS isDeleted FROM trip_checklist_items WHERE id = #{itemId} AND trip_id = #{tripId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_checklist_items (trip_id, template_id, checklist_type, dday_stage, item_name, is_completed, is_excluded, is_custom, is_carried_over) SELECT #{tripId} AS trip_id, id AS template_id, checklist_type, dday_stage, item_name, 0 AS is_completed, 0 AS is_excluded, 0 AS is_custom, 0 AS is_carried_over FROM checklist_templates

INSERT INTO trip_checklist_items (trip_id, template_id, checklist_type, dday_stage, item_name, is_completed, is_excluded, is_custom, is_carried_over, is_deleted) VALUES (#{tripId}, NULL, -- 사용자 추가 항목은 template_id가 NULL #{checklistType}, #{ddayStage}, #{itemName}, 0, -- is_completed 초기값 false (0) 0, -- is_excluded 초기값 false (0) 1, -- is_custom = 1 (사용자 커스텀) 0, -- is_carried_over 초기값 false (0) 0 -- is_deleted 초기값 0 )
